newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort launches new China joint ventures.
newsitem.headline: Comfort launches new China joint ventures.

text.p: Transport company Comfort Group Ltd said on Monday it had formed a new unit in China to provide bus tour services in Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

The new unit, Zhengzhou Comfort Tour Bus Service Co Ltd, would have a registered capital of Rmb 10 million, and be 60 percent owned by Comfort and 40 percent by Zhengzhou Municipal Yellow River Travel Agency, a Chinese state-owned travel agency.

Comfort said in a statement the joint venture was in line with its objective of "capitalising on its technical and management expertise to invest in China's land transport system and to enhance its position as a diversified regional land
The venture, the first foray for Comfort into tourist-related business in China, is due to begin offering services in the last quarter of 1997.
Comfort said it expected to invest an initial Rmb 18 million in a fleet of 20 buses.

Comfort added that it had also formed a petrol service station unit, Suzhou Industrial Park Zhong Xing Comfort Petrol Service Co Ltd, registered in the China-Singapore Suzhou Industrial Park. It expects this unit to begin trading in 1998.
